name: binhex-official-filebrowser-quantum
description: FileBrowser Quantum is an actively maintained fork of the original filebrowser with full-text search, previews and thumbnails, sharing links, multi-source support and optional OIDC, LDAP and proxy authentication. Its primary configuration is config.yaml inside the data volume, so most settings are edited there rather than exposed here; the environment variables below cover secrets and overrides.
